verdict.rationale: Sprinto has a documented integrations catalog under /integrations/overview, with step-by-step pages for Jira and ClickUp (ticketing), JumpCloud (identity/device management), and FreeAgent (used to map offboarded users). Integration monitoring and webhooks support collection beyond the catalog, and the docs claim pre-mapped integrations automate evidence collection. However, the pack only shows a few categories of the story's stack, and nothing addresses permission scopes. Missing for 10: cloud provider integrations (AWS/GCP/Azure), code hosting integrations (GitHub/GitLab), explicit HR/MDM coverage, documentation of read-only scopes, and independent hands-on corroboration.
